positions.title: Intelligence Analyst
positions.description:
•	Supported all aspects of Air Force operations by gathering, analyzing, evaluating and disseminating finished intelligence products. 
•	Produced all-source intelligence, situation updates, order-of-battle studies, and other intelligence reports. 
•	Advised commanders on force protection and intelligence information for US forces during operation FREEDOM's SENTINEL. 
•	Conducted intel post-mission briefings of US and allied military personnel during exercise and combat operations. 
•	Prepared post mission reports and presented pre-mission briefings. 
•	Revitalized F-35 mission qualification program. 
•	Instructed aircrews on assessing offensive and defensive weapon system capabilities and counter tactics. 
•	Recommended counter-tactics to pilots based on threat system analysis. 
•	Performed random anti-terrorism measures for the protection of US forces.
